caption: The drawing depicts a section of an interior staircase, focusing on the lower portion where the stairs meet the landing. The staircase steps are colored in a light gray or off-white shade, and the handrail system is prominently featured in the foreground. The handrail, balusters, and newel posts are rendered in a warm brown wood tone, showing variations in grain and shading typical of polished or varnished wood. The handrail curves at the corner, supported by vertical balusters and two larger, rectangular newel posts anchored to the light, floorboards of the landing. The composition is centered on this architectural detail, with the background consisting solely of ascending steps and no additional objects or decoration visible. The drawing overall is bordered by a neutral, lightly textured margin.
title: Newel Post
